type: read-only teachable-unit disposition for held 3860, held 2331/2367 and provisional 4151

items.sourceSentence: A good policy tackles both the symptoms and the roots of the problem.
items.reason: Owner 1104 already teaches immediate effects versus underlying causes and expressly permits useful symptom relief while investigating the cause. The both/and source is the positive completion of the same decision; its different wording is not enough for a distinct seven-step lesson. Current target regex does not cover the full source, so an alias would require a substantive two-construction owner review rather than a detector-only addition.

items.sourceSentence: She has an understated but powerful screen presence.
items.reason: Screen presence is a natural noun phrase, but selected 2332 already tests captivating on-camera performance, including quiet and brief-role performances, and even explains a key as engaging screen presence. A noun-versus-verb distinction alone does not create a distinct learner decision; the prior proposed lesson repeated filmed-presenter attention. A two-construction merge would materially alter the selected owner and needs separate adjudication.

items.sourceSentence: We should not outsource every detail to our phones.
items.reason: The figurative delegation of remembering details to a tool is teachable with an explicit boundary from overdependence and independent decisions; independent editorial review remains pending.
